def select(R,old):
 op=old.Counter();out=dict(mode='unresolved',trials=[])
 try:
  a,b,det,data=moment.full_geometry(R,op);out.update(a=a.v,b=b.v,det=det.v)
  scale=det/PI12;lo=scale/(b*b);hi=scale/(a*a);mid=(lo+hi)/2;err=(hi-lo)/2
  out['interval']=[lo.v,hi.v]
  if err<=TOL:out.update(mode='interval',value=mid.v,bound=err.v)
  else:
   mu,var,eq2=moment.moments(data);out['moment']=dict(mean=mu.v,variance=var.v,second=eq2.v)
   if var<=0 or mu<=0:out['moment']['failure']='Nonpositive floating variance/mean; shortcut not used'
   else:
    lower=scale/(mu*mu);a2=a*a;upper=lower+3*scale*var/(a2*a2);ml=max(lo,lower);mh=min(hi,upper)
    if mh<ml:out['moment']['failure']='Floating interval intersection reversed; shortcut not used'
    else:
     mm=(ml+mh)/2;me=(mh-ml)/2;out['moment'].update(interval=[ml.v,mh.v],bound=me.v)
     if me<=TOL:
      out.update(mode='interval',value=mm.v,bound=me.v,moment_used=True,setup_selection_counts=op.dict());return out
   alpha=(a+b)/2;delta=(a*b).root();sa=a.root();sb=b.root();rho=(sb-sa)/(sb+sa);one=1-rho;scale=det/PI6
   for n in PROTOCOL['orders']:
    power=rho
    for _ in range(n-2):power=power*rho
    tail=2*power/(delta*delta*delta)*(alpha/one+delta*((n-1)/one+rho/(one*one)));bd=scale*tail
    out['trials'].append(dict(order=n,bound=bd.v))
    if bd<=TOL:out.update(mode='quadrature',order=n,bound=bd.v);break
   else:out['reason']='Center bound misses finite-order target'
 except Exception as exc:out['reason']=type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc)
 out['setup_selection_counts']=op.dict();return out

def stable_moments(data):
 A,s,r,d=data;t=add(d);off=[dot(A[i],A[j]) for i in range(4) for j in range(i+1,4)];mu=(s+t)/20;center=5*mu
 row_deviations=[r[i]+d[i]-center for i in range(4)]
 entry_deviations=[x-mu for x in d+off]
 var=(add([x*x for x in row_deviations])+add([x*x for x in entry_deviations]))/210
 second=var+mu*mu
 return mu,var,second
